sources.title: Homepage — community-driven AI tools directory (500+ verified tools); 'Submit an AI Tool: Free to list. No paid placements.'

requirements: AI software tools only — directory is explicitly 'artificial intelligence software' across 11 categories
Homepage states 'Free to list. No paid placements' and 'free forever for users and creators'
Listings include verified pricing models, role tags, killer features, pros & cons — expect data-verification style review
preparation: Category pick (coding, ai-agents, writing, image-gen, video-tools, marketing, productivity, design, research, chatbots, voice-ai)
Role tags (developer, student, marketer, founder, designer, content-creator, freelancer)
Pricing model (Free / Freemium / Paid / Free Trial) with accurate details — pricing is 'verified'
Killer features plus honest pros & cons
workflow: Open https://www.usefuturestack.com/submit — page is client-rendered; use a real browser
Complete the submission form (site claims listing is free)
Submitted tools appear on /tools/[slug] pages and in category/role listings after review
watchFor: The /submit page returned only nav chrome to a text fetcher — the form is JS-only; an automated agent needs browser rendering or DOM inspection to complete it
Documented MCP/OpenAPI surface is read-only — no public API submission endpoint is published
Possibly account-gated: nav shows notifications/subscribe elements; sign-in requirement unverified
Community upvotes drive ranking; a fresh listing starts at zero
countsAsLive: A /tools/<slug> page exists for the product on usefuturestack.com and it appears in its category listing
unknowns: Exact form fields on /submit (JS-rendered, not readable as text)
Whether an account is required to submit
